From global WEF white papers advocating for alternative proteins, to an explosion in red meat allergies.

audio_track_actual: Single female voiceover (selfie/talking-head in a vehicle), no music bed.
video_overlay_text_observed: Burned-in auto-captions mirroring the voiceover ('have you ever noticed how sometimes the world's biggest problems…'); occasional document/screenshot inserts referenced in narration (WEF papers, the Oxitec CEO quote).
audio_content_summary: Argues a coordinated 'global blueprint' to dismantle traditional meat-eating: WEF papers urging a shift to alternative proteins (synthetic meat, plant-based, insects), an engineered surge in tick-borne alpha-gal red-meat allergy, ticks allegedly air-dropped onto farms, and a Gates-funded Oxitec cattle-tick genetic program based near Oxford — tied together as deliberate centralization of control over food production.
implied_frame: Frames distinct, separately-documented items as one intentional chain ('shared global blueprint … where a select few control the technology behind what we eat'). Group A facts, each recorded on its own terms: WEF 'Alternative Proteins' white paper (2019-wef-alt-proteins-001); CDC's 2023 alpha-gal case count (2023-alpha-gal-001); the Gates/Oxitec genetically-engineered cattle-tick program (2021-oxitec-gates-tick-001). The CAUSAL LINK between them is the reel's inference, not in the records: the Oxitec tick is the Asian cattle tick R. microplus and its design suppresses the tick population, while alpha-gal in the US comes from the lone star tick (A. americanum) — a different species (PolitiFact rated the engineered-tick/meat-allergy connection false). Group C, no primary trace (NOT recorded): boxes of ticks 'falling from the sky' onto private fields, and an anonymous Ontario charter-pilot 'leak' claiming paid twice-yearly tick air-drops. The closing 'select few control … what we eat' is insinuation built by adjacency, not evidence.
capture_method: Pristine original media + metadata pulled from Instagram's CDN via yt-dlp; delivery webm derived once (VP9 video copied, audio normalized to -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP off the source AAC — no re-recording, no in-place re-encode).
